# Sarthak Agrawal

> Personal site of Sarthak Agrawal — AI infrastructure and product engineer. Portfolio, shipped products, and technical writing.

Built on Astro, deployed on Cloudflare Pages. Part of the Foundry personal product fleet.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/): Hero, selected work, and contact
- [Projects](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/projects): Full project archive; the landing page leads with four products plus SaaS Maker
- [About](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/about): Background, stack, and availability
- [Résumé](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/resume): On-site résumé and PDF download
- [Writing](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/blog): Devlog and technical posts
- [Privacy](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/privacy): Privacy policy
- [Fleet performance without Argo](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/blog/fleet-performance-without-argo): Case study on closing desktop LCP p75 under 500 ms across 23 Cloudflare sites

## Product fleet

### Spotlight

- [CodeVetter](https://codevetter.com): Desktop-first AI code review for agent-generated diffs
- [PostTrainLLM](https://posttrainllm.com): Post-training and small-language-model learning workspace
- [HeyPace](https://heypace.app): Local-only macOS voice agent
- [High Signal](https://highsignal.app): Evidence-first signal log for AI infrastructure, markets, and domain intelligence
- [SaaS Maker](https://sassmaker.com): Broader directory and operating layer for the full product fleet

### Full directory

- The broader project archive is maintained at [SaaS Maker](https://sassmaker.com)
- [High Signal](https://highsignal.app): Public signal log for AI infrastructure, markets, and domain intelligence
- [AliveVille](https://aliveville.com): Interactive AI world experiment
- [Free AI](https://github.com/sass-maker/free-ai): OpenAI-compatible gateway for free-tier model providers
- [Knowledge Base](https://github.com/sass-maker/knowledge-base): Private Agent Search over project-scoped corpora
- [Reel Pipeline](https://github.com/sass-maker/reel-pipeline): AI short-form video generation pipeline
- [Research Papers](https://github.com/High-Signal-App/research-papers): Academic paper platform and research data asset
- [drank](https://github.com/High-Signal-App/drank): Domain Rating tracker for domain research
- [Starboard](https://github.com/Codevetter/starboard): GitHub stars organizer and semantic search surface
